doc: One-time hints (FirstTimeHint): a single line shown the first time a thing matters, then never again on that save (Save.d.tutorial.hints). They took over the tutorial steps that were cut (owner, Nov 8: shorter tutorials). {action} shows that action's key ({dash}, {crouch}, {interact}...), {rank} the rank-up keys, {boki} the active Boki's name. match and heart (the Heartspark's lines and the Ways Out seats', not part of the old tutorials, so the v11 -> v12 migration leaves them): shown in a match by MatchHints; farm: on the farm by FarmHints. fight_quiet_s: no hint in the first seconds of a fight; one hint line on screen at a time (the next waits for the lane); sight_m: an outpost this close means no go-to-exit hint. A save that had finished the old tutorials sees none of its part (the v11 -> v12 migration).

match.exdash: Too far? Jump, then press {dash} in mid-air
match.crouch: Hold {crouch} to crouch and see farther
match.pickup: Gear! Walk over it to pick it up
match.orders: Tap {throw} to call {boki} back. Hold it for orders
match.rank: Skill point! Press {rank} to rank it up
match.key: A key! Hold {interact} at a chest to open it
match.uplink: Stand in the outpost's circle to start the uplink
match.defend: Stay in the circle until the lift opens
match.goexit: Outposts get you off the island. Look for one

farm.stone: The house needs stone too: hold {interact} at a rock
farm.hammer: Hold {interact} at the house to hammer it up
farm.task: Click {boki} to give it a job
farm.buy: Out of seeds? Buy more at the Market
farm.sell: Sell crops at the Market for gems
farm.hob: Hob the builder is at the stall: press {interact} to talk

heart.spark: Carry the Heart to the Gate to leave now, small reward
heart.carry: Everyone can see you. Reach a Heart Gate.
heart.lair_out: Beat the Sealed Lair: the winners fly out
heart.uplink_out: Hold an Uplink to be lifted out: one squad, once
heart.final_out: One squad leaves at the end with the big reward
heart.seat_grace: Your squad took a seat. Anyone not in it has {late_s} s to reach it or loses loot

when.exdash: you are in the air over the void
when.crouch: a while into a match, standing on open ground
when.pickup: gear lies within a few metres
when.orders: your Boki is out fighting for the first time
when.rank: you have a skill point to spend
when.utility: a monster has been close for 2 s and you have not used your other ability
when.key: you pick up a chest key
when.uplink: you walk near an outpost that can start
when.defend: an uplink of yours is charging
when.goexit: a few minutes into a match with no outpost close
when.spark: the Heartspark is charged and nobody carries it
when.carry: you carry the Heartspark (the Heart Gate is marked)
when.lair_out: the Sealed Lair seat has opened (heart.json quest lair_open_s)
when.uplink_out: the Uplink seat has opened (heart.json quest uplink_open_s)
when.final_out: the Heart final seat has opened
when.seat_grace: your squad takes a Ways Out seat (OneSeat): shown to the one who boards and the one left behind
when.stone: the house is marked out and short of stone
when.task: the house stands and no Boki has a job
when.hob: the tutorial is over and you have not talked to Hob
